name: FRRouting (FRR)
description: Free software implementing IPv4/IPv6 routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, RIP, PIM, LDP, BFD, EIGRP, NHRP, Babel, PBR, VRRP). Runs on Linux/BSD with YANG/NETCONF support via northbound plugins.

docker_support.docker_evidence: The repository contains a /docker directory and .dockerignore file, confirming Docker support is available.

eval_notes: The most widely-used open-source routing stack. Ideal for agentic evaluations involving multi-protocol routing configuration, troubleshooting, and verification. Can be combined with containerlab for complex topology labs. Most popular open-source routing suite. YANG models in /yang directory. NETCONF/RESTCONF via sysrepo/netopeer2 northbound plugins. Native Docker images available. Supports BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, LDP, BFD, PIM, and many more protocols.
